[b]Introduction:[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3]Shed & Big Shed for Alternative Textures. Features seasonal variation. Based on Garden Village Retexture.
[/size]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Installation:[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install all their required mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the file then put it into Stardew Valley\Mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Now you can open "shops" on the farm.[/size]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][b]Inspiration suggestion for mod use:
[/b][/size][/font]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309?tab=posts]Market Town - Food Store _ Flower Shop _ Fishery and more[/url], you can make the farm or island more Market Town atmosphere！
